# Data dictionary

*Generated by `pipeline/03_dictionary.R` on 2026-10-08 from `docs/field_notes.csv` and `docs/derived_fields.csv`. Missing rates are for regular-season pitches in the raw Savant data.*

Source: Baseball Savant Statcast search CSV, pulled one game day at a time with `baseballr::statcast_search()`. One row per pitch.

## How to read the columns

`known_when` is the leakage guard for the whole project:

- **before pitch**: known before the pitcher starts his motion. Only these can be model features.
- **after pitch**: measured on the pitch itself (velocity, location, result). Used in the report, never as a feature for the same pitch.
- **after PA**: filled in when the plate appearance ends.
- **future**: only knowable in hindsight. Never used.
- **id**: identifiers and bookkeeping.

`use`:

- **feature**: model input (Phase 2)
- **target**: what the model predicts
- **report**: shown in the matchup report
- **filter / id**: used for cleaning or joining
- **dropped**: not carried into the clean table

## Fields added by the pipeline

| field | meaning | known_when | use |
|---|---|---|---|
| pitcher_name | Pitcher's full name, from the MLB Stats API. | id | id |
| batter_name | Batter's name (Statcast player_name renamed for clarity). | id | id |
| pitch_group | One of 8 groups: FF, SI, FC, SL, ST, CU (curve, knuckle curve, slurve, slow curve), CH, FS (splitter, forkball). Empty for pitches outside the groups. | after pitch | target |
| pitch_group_name | Readable name of pitch_group. | after pitch | report |
| target_status | model = a prediction target; non_pitch = automatic ball/strike, pitchout or intentional ball; rare_type = eephus, knuckleball, etc.; unclassified = no pitch type. | after pitch | filter |
| pitcher_team | Team the pitcher plays for in this game (home team when inning_topbot = Top). | before pitch | report |
| batter_team | Team the batter plays for in this game. | before pitch | report |
| count_str | Count before the pitch as text, e.g. 1-2. | before pitch | feature |
| runners_on | Number of runners on base before the pitch (0-3). | before pitch | feature |
| base_state | Which bases are occupied, e.g. 1_3 = first and third. | before pitch | feature |
| score_diff | Pitching team's score minus batting team's score before the pitch (positive = pitcher's team leads). | before pitch | feature |
| pa_id | Unique plate-appearance id: game_pk * 1000 + at_bat_number. | id | id |
| pitcher_game_pitch_no | The pitcher's pitch count in this game before and including this pitch (1 = first pitch of his outing). | before pitch | feature |
| pitcher_game_pa_no | Which batter faced (1st PA of the outing = 1) this pitch belongs to. | before pitch | feature |
| is_starter | TRUE if this pitcher threw his team's first pitch of the game. Known before the game starts, so allowed as a feature. | before pitch | feature |

## Schema checks

Every Savant column is documented.

No documented column has disappeared from the feed.
